stem: A plant is removed because of a suspected contagious problem. What follow-up action best supports IPM verification?
choices: Continue targeted scouting around the original location and relevant movement pathways to determine whether similar signs appear elsewhere
Close the incident immediately because removal guarantees containment
Stop sanitation so remaining plants are easier to inspect
Move nearby plants throughout the facility to test whether symptoms spread
rationale: Removal is one action, not proof of containment. Follow-up surveillance around the affected zone and plausible pathways helps determine whether additional cases are present.
